entries.title: Large crowd causes Lake Shore Drive closure at 57th Street
entries.summary: <p>A portion of South DuSable Lake Shore Drive was closed Monday night after large crowds caused a heavy police presence in Jackson Park.</p><p>Traffic was closed around 9 p.m. on Lake Shore Drive at 57th Street, Chicago police said.</p><p>Around 1,000 people were seen gathered in the area, some jumping on top of cars. A few people in the crowd were seen throwing objects, and others charged toward a line of police officers.</p><p>No arrests were reported. The crowd size had dwindled by 10 p.m. </p><p>On Friday, University of Chicago Police issued an alert about a possible “teen takeover” gathering that had been planned for Monday night near 57th Street </div><p>Officers also were on scene of another large crowd gathered Monday night at North Avenue Beach, police said.</p><p>Chicago police did not have any further information.</p><p>On Sunday, another "unauthorized large gathering" apparently involving teens that ended with a driver veering into five Chicago police officers, injuring them, as they were dispersing the crowd on the Near West Side. </p><p>An 18-year-old man was <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/crime/2026/05/24/cpd-officers-hurt-near-west-side-gathering" target="_blank" >charged with attempted murder</a> in that incident. </p><p>“I continue to call on parents and guardians to know where their children are and to help ensure they are safe and accounted for,” Mayor Brandon Johnson said after Sunday's early-morning incident.</p>
